nativeValidation.method: Read every current root after composition; read back 64 representative native reactions. Slogan-only edits preserve hierarchy and links.

settings.sourceConfig: Address/scope, domain and target, cadence, first-history scope and exclusions; detect existing values before asking.
settings.sourceLifecycle: Detect → preview exact scope → explicit confirmation → effective receipt → observe first collection; enable is distinct from successful sync.
settings.sourcePause: Stops new collection; keeps evidence and existing work. Disconnect stops future access without cancelling work or deleting shared credentials.
settings.backupTarget: Input only when missing or explicitly changed
settings.diagnostics: Inspect approved scope; validate exact draft; trusted apply receipt; separate recheck
settings.obsidian: Work materials: detect editor, select Vault, review exact scope, confirm; file collection, verification/adoption and projection receipts are separate.
settings.feishu: Interaction: credentials → self pairing → explicit test send → verified return → explicit enable. Read-only checks do not send messages. Changes/recovery invalidate old proofs.
settings.language: Follow system by default; all visible system text switches; source content and user drafts retain their original language.
